steps.what: Read the individual's current personal-care arrangements and existing support preferences
Care for the individual or family through actual companionship, personal assistance and support adjusting to changed lifestyles
outputs: actual personal care and companionship provided

steps.what: Write and save the actual care-visit entry on personal assistance provided and relevant observed difficulties
inputs: actual personal care and companionship provided

tasks.design: Use the care record's {OTHER} existing current-arrangements link for the small reference lookup. Keep personal care, companionship and the brief actual visit entry human; there is no new report or automated care advice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current arrangements and preferences may require separate record navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: A native current-arrangements link can remove that small repeated opening.
tasks.still_hard: Trust, dignity and changing family circumstances require responsive personal care.
tasks.human_edge: The aide attends to the person and family and adjusts support within the actual agreed arrangements.

ambition.what: Personal care and companionship remain direct human support.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: an existing care-arrangements link can reduce navigation but cannot replace companionship or personal assistance.

assumptions: {OTHER} means the current care record and physical care setting. Boundary includes actual current-arrangement reading, direct support and the existing brief visit entry read for care continuity, not a new family report or automatic transcript.

The existing care team/client process supplies client ID, current arrangements, relevant preferences and version/date. s1 retains reading, checking and manual fallback; s2 produces actual support/observations, and s3 all actual factual capture and checking. No clean new family-needs dataset is assumed.

Test the native current-arrangements link first. It removes1 of5 repeated navigation units, retaining4 for reading; all90 direct-care and5 existing note units stay. No note-drafting saving is assumed for an already brief entry. Ordinary same-system save inside s3 remains near-zero, fully retained and ungated without gain.
Shares are unmeasured workflow estimates. No model, recording, clinical decision or external send is introduced. Additional link repair beyond normal reading is counted below.
research_questions: Observe actual care-reference reading, personal support and the brief visit entry separately.

already_counted.description: Care-context reading, all personal support and actual visit-entry writing/persistence remain in s1-s3.

incremental.description: Maintain and repair the current care-arrangements link beyond normal visit reading.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=4+90+5=99. Gross1 less0.5 upkeep gives0.5. Conservative case: changed family arrangements require4.5 of5 lookup units; the0.5 gain only covers upkeep. Direct support and note writing remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train family members in bedside care

steps.what: Read the actual agreed bedside-care instructions and relevant family training needs
inputs: existing care arrangements and family questions

steps.what: Train family members through actual bedside-care explanation and demonstration within the agreed instructions
Observe family members practicing the bedside-care tasks and clarify actual difficulties or limits
outputs: observed family understanding and remaining questions

steps.what: Write and save the actual care entry on bedside-care training given and unresolved family questions
inputs: observed family understanding and remaining questions

tasks.design: Link actual bedside-care references from {DOCS} in the current care record {OTHER}. Retain explanation, demonstration, observed practice and the actual continuity-of-care entry; the tool supplies no new care instruction or competence certificate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current bedside-care instructions can require repeated retrieval before actual teaching.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links can shorten that retrieval while retaining substantive reading.
tasks.still_hard: Families need practical demonstration and responsive clarification, not a generic written answer.
tasks.human_edge: The aide observes actual understanding and recognizes unresolved needs within their role.

ambition.what: Family bedside-care training remains practical human instruction.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: links to actual bedside-care instructions can reduce retrieval without replacing practical family training and observed practice.

assumptions: {OTHER} is the current care record and physical bedside-care aids. Boundary includes reference reading, actual demonstration/practice and the existing brief care entry used by subsequent caregivers. No new training log, automatic competence assessment or family handout is invented.

The real care team supplies current instruction/reference, relevant support limits and date; the family supplies actual questions through the existing care interaction. s1 retains reading/currency checks and missing-reference fallback; s2-s3 all teaching and practice observation, s4 actual factual capture/checking. No new clean family-skill profile is assumed.

Test native reference links first. s1 removes only1.8 of15 repeated reference-opening units and retains13.2 for substantive reading; all other work remains. Ordinary same-system save inside s4 is near-zero, fully retained and ungated with no benefit. These are unmeasured task-specific estimates, not a common configure cut.

No model, recording, care-plan change or external send is proposed. Source-link repair beyond actual training reading is additional upkeep below; applicable care access and consultation arrangements need confirmation.
research_questions: Observe actual preparation reading, demonstration, family practice and the existing care entry separately.

already_counted.description: Substantive instruction reading, all demonstration/practice observation and actual care-entry writing remain in s1-s4.

incremental.description: Maintain current bedside-care reference links and repair revised sources beyond actual training reading.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=13.2+55+25+5=98.2. Gross1.8 less0.8 upkeep gives1. Conservative case: unfamiliar bedside aids require14.2 of15 reference units; the0.8 gain only covers upkeep. Demonstration, practice and actual care-entry writing remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Direct personal care and family training remain human. Existing care-reference links may remove only small repeated retrieval actions.
role.ambitious_version: Provide responsive personal support and practical family teaching with clear continuity notes, without new paperwork or automated care advice.
